name: Khravgodon
savenote: +2 circumstance to all saves vs. disease

defensiveAbilities.name: +2 Circumstance to All Saves vs. Disease
Feign Death
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The khravgodon is reduced below 70 HP

Effect The khravgodon collapses. It is Off-Guard and can use actions that require only its mind, but any other action ends the ruse.

A successful DC 18 Perception check to Seek or DC 18 Medicine check to Recall Knowledge is required to determine that the animal is not, in fact, dead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Revived Retaliation
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The khravgodon is attacked or disturbed by a creature within reach while Feigning Death

Effect The khravgodon Strikes the triggering creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crush Chitin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The khravgodon has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect The khravgodon bites the creature, dealing (2d12+9) Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw save) that ignores the first 5 of the target's Hardness or resistance to physical damage. On a failed save, the target also takes a -2 circumstance penalty to AC for 1 round.

Effect: Crush Chitin

offensiveAbilities.name: Grasping Tail
offensiveAbilities.description: A khravgodon can drag a Large or smaller creature it has Grabbed with its tail along with it when it Strides.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
